purpose: Fill compatible tangential-translation and wall-normal-axis rigid-rotation consumer coverage, and observe force-stage velocity routing without integration.
frozen_utility_dependency: tests/support/mdbc_vector_test.cpp, included with its main renamed; no old file is edited and no MLS/neighbour implementation is copied
build_contract: Root reviews and builds a separate companion with authoritative current CPU objects/libraries, replacing only main; bind this source, included utility, all compile/link inputs and generated XML/BI4. No build/solver is authorized by preparing these files.
future_output_contract: Fresh shallow tests/outputs/bv_mls_* only: aux_rows.csv, consumer_rows.csv, stage_rows.csv, bv_mls_complete.json and Run.out; execution/build receipts belong in tests/logs. Existing folders are refused.
fields: 2D/3D tangential constant translation v=(.5,.25,0), with y=0 in 2D: compatible with fixed horizontal FreeSlip.
3D rigid rotation about wall normal v=(-.4*y,.4*x,0): compatible with fixed horizontal FreeSlip, zero prestress and zero pressure; corrected elastic strain/compression targets are zero.
No new NoSlip shear test: the retained affine suite already covers compatible v_t proportional to wall distance.
checks: Actual production initialization, mDBC BoundMode/TangenVel, derivative-only MLS, FSType/C and fused Interaction_Forces_ct; fixed native IDs/counts and stationary horizontal plane.

SPR and each actual fused observer call leave all physical positions, velocities/rho, double stresses, p/p0 and native IDs byte unchanged. Legitimate preceding mDBC updates are not mislabelled as forbidden physical changes.
Analytic mirror ghost versus actual MLS: 32*FLT_EPSILON*max(.125,abs(expected_component)).

Actual fused MLS-versus-analytic-aux consumers retain S=20 Pa/s, P=2000 Pa/s, R=.02 kg/m3/s plus 2e-5*abs(reference). Corrected S/P are additionally checked against zero rigid-motion truth with those original floors.
Record div inferred from trace(Rsigma)/(3K) versus -PoreRate/Mf; raw density analytic bias is recorded, not forced equal to corrected divergence.

Stage observer injects tangential affine fields at amplitudes 1 and 2 without moving particles or advancing the clock. It uses the real production condition: mDBC only at predictor when MDBCCorrector=0, both stages when 1; SPR is rebuilt every stage. BoundMode, TangenVel and auxiliary components are recorded for each ROI wall.

MDBCCorrector=0 requires exact unchanged tangential ghost and refreshed analytic auxiliary; MDBCCorrector=1 requires twice the predictor tangential ghost within the original velocity tolerance. This verifies implemented routing, not physical accuracy of mixed time levels.
limits: No physical time integration, new solver trajectory, half-step/full-cycle acceptance, production or formal input edits, canonical binary replacement, build, Git or notifier execution.
This fixture deliberately excludes moving/curved/mixed-slip walls, NoPen, restart, plasticity, HG, shifting and drainage; those capabilities are not inferred from the two fixed FreeSlip inputs.

Initial stress is zero, so rigid rotation tests strain/compression nulls and ghost routing, not nonzero-prestress Jaumann objectivity. The separate consumer-only single-pair test addresses the suspected CPU writeback gate.
The force-stage observer labels are not actual t_n/t_n+dt/2 integrator states: only field amplitudes and InterStep flags are varied, with unchanged TimeStep=0 and Nstep=0.
